title: SMB2 EaSize/ReparseTags and WSL tags
description:
This patchset:
* adds Windows Subsystem for Linux reparse tags for special files
* fixes the interpretation of EaSize field which can also be a reparse tag

commits_data.message:
SMB2: add Windows Subsystem for Linux reparse tags

These tags are used to represent Unix special files in WSL.

commits_data.title: SMB2: fix EaSize field in QUERY DIR responses
commits_data.message:
SMB2: fix EaSize field in QUERY DIR responses

According to [MS-FSCC] if the file has the REPARSE_TAG attribute, the
EaSize field must be interpreted as a reparse tag for the following
info levels:

* FileFullDirectoryInfo
* FileBothDirectoryInfo
* FileIdFullDirectoryInfo
* FileIdBothDirectoryInfo
